en: Black‑and‑white view of a mountain spa town with a small river in a stone-lined channel curving through a valley. Pedestrians walk along the riverside path and a winding road. A large white resort/hotel building stands among coniferous trees, with wooded hills rising behind. Reverse side is printed in Romanian with a Romanian stamp and București postmark; caption indicates the view is from Olănești.
